observed_failure.interpretation: The same paired latent point remains dominant under both proposals; K8 improves its proposal density modestly but does not pass the peak-weight gate.

candidate_density.coordinates: Let x in R^11 be the existing unit-Jacobian temperature-coupled non-phase latent coordinates and phi=(common_phase,relative_phase) in T^2, each phase in [0,1).
candidate_density.adapted_core: qC(x,phi)=sum_k pi_k N_11(x;mu_k,Sigma_k) WN_2(phi; a_k+B_k(x-mu_k),Omega_k), with the phase mean reduced modulo one.
candidate_density.wrapped_normal: WN_2(phi;m,Omega)=sum_{n in Z^2} Normal_2(phi+n;m,Omega); the density is normalized on the unit torus and samples by reducing a Gaussian draw modulo one.
candidate_density.defensive_mixture: q(z)=0.50*q_base(z)+0.25*qC(x(z),phi(z))*prod_j phi_std(z_phase_j)+0.25*q_broad(z). q_broad is the existing normalized broad-tail component; retain its exact density.
candidate_density.normalization: The wrapped-normal lattice sum is normalized on T^2; each Gaussian is normalized on R^11; mixture weights sum to one; the phase map (u_primary,u_secondary)->(common,relative) has unit torus Jacobian; include both standard-normal CDF Jacobians when evaluating density in latent z. The base defensive component preserves prior support.
candidate_density.fit: Fit B_k and Omega_k from preserved weighted training samples only, with positive-definite regularization specified before any held-out evaluation; do not fit on held-out outcomes.

required_validation_before_use: Implement lattice-sum density with a numerical truncation error bound and verify unit-torus normalization independently.
Check sampling/log-density agreement and all transform Jacobians against independent numerical tests.
Freeze proposal hash, training rows, seeds, and thresholds before held-out likelihood calls.
At (2.000,13.50), repeat independent 512-draw seeds only after preflight; retain every finite sample and do not clip weights.
Require the existing ESS>=100, max normalized weight<=0.05, phase ESS>=30 per phase, log-integral spread<=0.2 and 256-to-512 drift<=0.1 gates.
